en.title: FEES Schedule 6, 6.4: the Recognised Non-AIFC Member trading value fee is ambiguous for members on several platforms
en.summary: The trading value fee applies to members "whose trading value is over 25 million USD per quarter on each trading platform". For a member above the threshold on one platform and below it on another, the text can mean that no fee is due (not over the threshold on each platform) or that a fee is due per platform; the base ("0.001% of trading value") does not say whether it is per platform or in total.
en.correction: Please state whether the USD 25 million quarterly threshold applies per platform or across platforms, and specify the trading-value base of the variable fee.
